column1: # roborepo install manifest — single source of truth for managed home<->repo paths.
# Hand-duplicated across 7+ scripts before this file existed (install/main.sh,
#   harness   claude | codex                 which harness this row belongs to
#   kind      link | root_config | cleanup    behavior (see below)
#   src_rel   path under repo root, or "-" for cleanup rows (no repo source)
#   home_sub  path relative to the harness home dir (claude=~/.claude, codex=~/.codex);
#             the reader joins the home root
#   home_root home dir token: claude=~/.claude  codex=~/.codex
#               nodoctor  = not checked by doctor --installed (verify still checks)
#               nosync    = not pulled from live home config by sync-from-home.sh
#   link         clean symlink home_sub -> repo/src_rel (link_item_clean / check_link)
#   root_config  mutable user state: copied not linked, adopt-on-collision
#   cleanup      remove a stale repo-managed symlink at home path; src_rel is "-"
# ^^^ plugin cleanup rows: legacy guards from the era when roborepo dir-linked plugins/ into the repo.
# That dir-linking was removed; these rows now serve uninstall (remove orphaned managed links) and
# relocation (reclaim a stale managed link after a repo move). The live plugin registry
# (installed_plugins.json, known_marketplaces.json) is always a native real file — these rows never touch it.
# ^^^ migration: removes any old dir-level ~/.claude/skills -> globals/claude/skills symlink.
# skills/ is now managed per-skill by the installer's enumerate-step, not as a dir-level link.
# ^^^ migration: removes any old dir-level ~/.codex/skills -> repo symlink (pre-native-alignment era).
# skills/ is now managed per-skill by the installer's enumerate-step.
